analysis_method: Clang AST observations plus candidate-bound source-order checks over the declared fixed-storage, allocation, validation, checkpoint, and benchmark-independence invariants.
assumptions: The C compiler preserves the declared fixed object bounds.

boundedness.description: Nine explicit checks over one candidate translation unit and included state declarations.

limitations: The provider does not establish arbitrary C semantics outside the declared invariant set.
requirement: The processor uses fixed-capacity device, metric, window, and parser storage and contains no processor-path dynamic allocation.
